name: 60439 · Lemont, IL
findings: ZIP 60439 (Lemont) has 117 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60439 (Lemont) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60439 (Lemont) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
